definition_en: measurement or equipment category defining where an instrument may be safely used
definition_es: categoría que define dónde puede utilizarse de forma segura un instrumento
example_en: Select a meter with a rated category suitable for the task.

definition_en: equipment and methods used to lift, move or position loads
definition_es: equipos y métodos utilizados para izar, mover o posicionar cargas
example_en: Inspect the rigging before lifting the equipment.

definition_en: flexible lifting device used to support a load
definition_es: dispositivo flexible de izaje usado para soportar una carga
example_en: Select the sling for the load and lifting arrangement.

definition_en: rigging connector used between lifting components
definition_es: conector de aparejo usado entre componentes de izaje
example_en: Verify the shackle is suitable for the lift.

definition_en: maximum load a lifting component is rated to carry in service
definition_es: carga máxima para la cual un componente de izaje está clasificado
example_en: Do not exceed the working load limit.

definition_en: tool used to tighten a fastener to a specified torque
definition_es: herramienta para apretar un sujetador a un torque especificado
example_en: Use a torque wrench for the busbar connections.

definition_en: test instrument used to measure insulation resistance
definition_es: instrumento usado para medir la resistencia de aislamiento
example_en: Use an insulation resistance tester on the cable before startup.

definition_en: meter that measures current by clamping around a conductor
definition_es: medidor que mide corriente abrazando un conductor
example_en: Use a clamp-on ammeter to compare phase currents.

definition_en: device that displays surface temperature patterns using infrared radiation
definition_es: dispositivo que muestra patrones de temperatura superficial mediante infrarrojo
example_en: Use thermographic imaging to identify abnormal heating.

definition_en: high-potential dielectric test used to assess insulation withstand
definition_es: prueba dieléctrica de alto potencial usada para evaluar aislamiento
example_en: Perform the hi-pot test according to the approved procedure.

definition_en: instrument used to identify three-phase phase sequence or rotation
definition_es: instrumento usado para identificar la secuencia de fases
example_en: Confirm phase rotation before starting the motor.

definition_en: instrument used to verify an electrical path is continuous
definition_es: instrumento usado para verificar continuidad eléctrica
example_en: Use a continuity tester to identify conductors.

definition_en: simplified drawing showing major electrical system connections using one line per circuit path
definition_es: plano simplificado que muestra conexiones principales con una línea por circuito
example_en: Cross-reference the single-line diagram before isolation.

definition_en: drawing showing functional electrical relationships and circuit logic
definition_es: diagrama que muestra relaciones funcionales y lógica de circuito
example_en: Use the schematic to trace the control circuit.

definition_en: drawing key that defines symbols and abbreviations
definition_es: clave del plano que define símbolos y abreviaturas
example_en: Check the legend before interpreting the symbol.

definition_en: ratio used to relate drawing dimensions to actual dimensions
definition_es: relación usada para convertir dimensiones del plano a dimensiones reales
example_en: Use the drawing scale to locate the equipment.

definition_en: document listing circuits and related information for a panelboard
definition_es: documento que enumera circuitos e información asociada de un panel
example_en: Verify the circuit on the panel schedule.

definition_en: operations and maintenance documentation for equipment or systems
definition_es: documentación de operación y mantenimiento de equipos o sistemas
example_en: Review the O&M manual before commissioning.

definition_en: documented baseline information and test results from commissioning
definition_es: información base y resultados documentados durante commissioning
example_en: Compare the maintenance result with the commissioning record.

definition_en: manufacturer-marked ratings and identification shown on equipment
definition_es: valores nominales e identificación indicados por el fabricante
example_en: Check the nameplate data before setting parameters.

definition_en: setting or measured value defining intended equipment operation
definition_es: ajuste o valor medido que define la operación prevista del equipo
example_en: Set the operational parameters to the manufacturer specification.

definition_en: specified order used to safely de-energize or stop a system
definition_es: orden especificado para detener o desenergizar un sistema
example_en: Follow the shutdown sequence before maintenance.

definition_en: specified order used to safely energize or start a system
definition_es: orden especificado para energizar o arrancar un sistema
example_en: Follow the startup sequence after all checks are complete.

term_es: puesta a tierra temporal de protección
definition_en: temporary grounding equipment applied during certain shutdown work
definition_es: equipo temporal de puesta a tierra utilizado durante ciertos trabajos de paro
example_en: Remove the temporary protective ground before startup when required.

definition_en: area where hazardous substances may require special electrical installation methods
definition_es: área donde sustancias peligrosas pueden exigir métodos eléctricos especiales
example_en: Check the hazardous location classification before selecting equipment.

definition_en: designation describing hazardous-location conditions and requirements
definition_es: designación que describe condiciones y requisitos de una ubicación peligrosa
example_en: Use the area classification drawing for the installation.

definition_en: fitting used where sealing is required in certain hazardous installations
definition_es: accesorio usado donde se requiere sellado en determinadas instalaciones peligrosas
example_en: Install the seal fitting at the required location.

definition_en: conductor associated with an electrical supply service
definition_es: conductor asociado con el servicio de alimentación eléctrica
example_en: Inspect the service conductors during maintenance.

definition_en: enclosure and connection point designed to receive an electrical meter
definition_es: gabinete y punto de conexión diseñado para recibir un medidor
example_en: Inspect the meter socket and associated wiring.

definition_en: instrument transformer used to reproduce a scaled current for metering or protection
definition_es: transformador de instrumento que entrega una corriente proporcional para medición o protección
example_en: The current transformer feeds the metering circuit.

definition_en: instrument transformer used to reproduce a scaled voltage for metering or protection
definition_es: transformador de instrumento que entrega un voltaje proporcional para medición o protección
example_en: Verify the potential transformer circuit before testing the meter.

definition_en: rigid conductor used to distribute electrical power within equipment
definition_es: conductor rígido usado para distribuir energía dentro de un equipo
example_en: Verify busbar connections and torque.

definition_en: assembly of switching, protection and control equipment used in power systems
definition_es: conjunto de equipos de maniobra, protección y control de sistemas eléctricos
example_en: Inspect the switchgear according to the maintenance schedule.

definition_en: assembly containing buses and overcurrent devices for branch or feeder distribution
definition_es: conjunto con barras y dispositivos de sobrecorriente para distribución
example_en: Verify the panelboard circuit identification.

definition_en: conductors supplying power from one distribution point to another downstream point
definition_es: conductores que suministran energía entre puntos de distribución
example_en: The feeder supplies the downstream panel.

definition_en: final circuit supplying utilization equipment or outlets from the last overcurrent device
definition_es: circuito final que alimenta cargas desde el último dispositivo de sobrecorriente
example_en: Test the branch circuit after replacing the wiring device.

definition_en: device or means used to disconnect equipment or a circuit from its source
definition_es: dispositivo usado para desconectar un equipo o circuito de su fuente
example_en: Open and isolate the disconnect before maintenance.

definition_en: component of a protective device that determines when it trips
definition_es: componente de un dispositivo de protección que determina cuándo dispara
example_en: Verify the trip unit settings against the coordination requirements.

definition_en: coordination intended to isolate a fault with the protective device closest to it
definition_es: coordinación destinada a aislar una falla con el dispositivo más cercano
example_en: Review protection settings for selective coordination.

definition_en: relay used to detect or act on ground-fault conditions
definition_es: relé usado para detectar o actuar ante fallas a tierra
example_en: Test the ground-fault relay according to the maintenance procedure.

term_es: resistencia de puesta a tierra del neutro
definition_en: resistor used to limit ground-fault current in an impedance-grounded system
definition_es: resistencia usada para limitar corriente de falla a tierra en un sistema con neutro por impedancia
example_en: Inspect the neutral grounding resistor and detection circuit.

definition_en: conductive element used to connect a grounding system to earth
definition_es: elemento conductor usado para conectar el sistema de puesta a tierra con tierra
example_en: Inspect the grounding electrode system.

definition_en: conductor or connection used to maintain electrical bonding continuity
definition_es: conductor o conexión usada para mantener continuidad de bonding
example_en: Verify the bonding jumper is intact.

definition_en: mechanical source that drives an electrical generator
definition_es: fuente mecánica que impulsa un generador eléctrico
example_en: The prime mover drives the AC generator.

definition_en: generator component/system that provides field excitation
definition_es: componente/sistema que proporciona excitación al campo del generador
example_en: Inspect the exciter during generator troubleshooting.
